name: Corn-Soybean Ratio Around USDA Prospective Plantings
description: Event study analyzing the corn/soybean price ratio in the [-10, +10] trading day window around USDA Prospective Plantings reports (2016-2025). Normalizes each event to 0 at day -1, classifies events as Ratio Rose vs Fell based on day 0 to +5 move, and reports average paths, per-year impacts, and summary statistics.
source:
# =============================================================================
# CORN-SOYBEAN RATIO EVENT STUDY: USDA PROSPECTIVE PLANTINGS
# =============================================================================
# Analyzes the ZC/ZS ratio in a [-10, +10] trading day window around each
# hardcoded USDA Prospective Plantings release date (2016-2025).
# Normalizes each event's ratio path to 0 at day -1 (cumulative change).
# Classifies events as "Ratio Rose" vs "Ratio Fell" by day 0 → day +5 move.
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCES ===
src = market_data_source()()
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
corn_close = cont.c

# Soybean reference data (continuous front-month from Epoch Archive)
zs_ref = reference_futures(ticker="ZS")()
soy_close = zs_ref.c

# === CORN / SOYBEAN RATIO ===
ratio = corn_close / soy_close

# === EVENT DATE DETECTION ===
# All USDA Prospective Plantings releases occur in late March.
bar_idx = index()
yr = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(bar_idx)
mo = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(bar_idx)
dy = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day)(bar_idx)

is_march = mo == 3

# Day 31 events: 2016, 2017, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2025
is_d31_event = is_march and dy == 31 and (yr == 2016 or yr == 2017 or yr == 2020 or yr == 2021 or yr == 2022 or yr == 2023 or yr == 2025)
# Day 29 events: 2018, 2019
is_d29_event = is_march and dy == 29 and (yr == 2018 or yr == 2019)
# Day 28 event: 2024
is_d28_event = is_march and dy == 28 and yr == 2024

is_event = is_d31_event or is_d29_event or is_d28_event

# === RATIO VALUES AT KEY OFFSETS (relative to event bar) ===
# >> N = N bars ago (pre-event), << N = N bars ahead (post-event)
r_base = ratio >> 1   # day -1 (normalization anchor)

r_m10 = ratio >> 10
r_m9  = ratio >> 9
r_m8  = ratio >> 8
r_m7  = ratio >> 7
r_m6  = ratio >> 6
r_m5  = ratio >> 5
r_m4  = ratio >> 4
r_m3  = ratio >> 3
r_m2  = ratio >> 2
r_m1  = ratio >> 1
r_0   = ratio
r_p1  = ratio << 1
r_p2  = ratio << 2
r_p3  = ratio << 3
r_p4  = ratio << 4
r_p5  = ratio << 5
r_p6  = ratio << 6
r_p7  = ratio << 7
r_p8  = ratio << 8
r_p9  = ratio << 9
r_p10 = ratio << 10

# === NORMALIZED CHANGES (from day -1 base) ===
n_m10 = where(is_event, r_m10 - r_base)
n_m9  = where(is_event, r_m9  - r_base)
n_m8  = where(is_event, r_m8  - r_base)
n_m7  = where(is_event, r_m7  - r_base)
n_m6  = where(is_event, r_m6  - r_base)
n_m5  = where(is_event, r_m5  - r_base)
n_m4  = where(is_event, r_m4  - r_base)
n_m3  = where(is_event, r_m3  - r_base)
n_m2  = where(is_event, r_m2  - r_base)
n_m1  = where(is_event, 0.0)
n_0   = where(is_event, r_0   - r_base)
n_p1  = where(is_event, r_p1  - r_base)
n_p2  = where(is_event, r_p2  - r_base)
n_p3  = where(is_event, r_p3  - r_base)
n_p4  = where(is_event, r_p4  - r_base)
n_p5  = where(is_event, r_p5  - r_base)
n_p6  = where(is_event, r_p6  - r_base)
n_p7  = where(is_event, r_p7  - r_base)
n_p8  = where(is_event, r_p8  - r_base)
n_p9  = where(is_event, r_p9  - r_base)
n_p10 = where(is_event, r_p10 - r_base)

# === REGIME CLASSIFICATION ===
# "Ratio Rose" = day +5 ratio > day 0 ratio
ratio_rose_flag = (ratio << 5) > ratio
is_rose = is_event and ratio_rose_flag
is_fell = is_event and (not ratio_rose_flag)

# Normalized paths for Rose regime
rose_m10 = where(is_rose, r_m10 - r_base)
rose_m9  = where(is_rose, r_m9  - r_base)
rose_m8  = where(is_rose, r_m8  - r_base)
rose_m7  = where(is_rose, r_m7  - r_base)
rose_m6  = where(is_rose, r_m6  - r_base)
rose_m5  = where(is_rose, r_m5  - r_base)
rose_m4  = where(is_rose, r_m4  - r_base)
rose_m3  = where(is_rose, r_m3  - r_base)
rose_m2  = where(is_rose, r_m2  - r_base)
rose_m1  = where(is_rose, 0.0)
rose_0   = where(is_rose, r_0   - r_base)
rose_p1  = where(is_rose, r_p1  - r_base)
rose_p2  = where(is_rose, r_p2  - r_base)
rose_p3  = where(is_rose, r_p3  - r_base)
rose_p4  = where(is_rose, r_p4  - r_base)
rose_p5  = where(is_rose, r_p5  - r_base)
rose_p6  = where(is_rose, r_p6  - r_base)
rose_p7  = where(is_rose, r_p7  - r_base)
rose_p8  = where(is_rose, r_p8  - r_base)
rose_p9  = where(is_rose, r_p9  - r_base)
rose_p10 = where(is_rose, r_p10 - r_base)

# Normalized paths for Fell regime
fell_m10 = where(is_fell, r_m10 - r_base)
fell_m9  = where(is_fell, r_m9  - r_base)
fell_m8  = where(is_fell, r_m8  - r_base)
fell_m7  = where(is_fell, r_m7  - r_base)
fell_m6  = where(is_fell, r_m6  - r_base)
fell_m5  = where(is_fell, r_m5  - r_base)
fell_m4  = where(is_fell, r_m4  - r_base)
fell_m3  = where(is_fell, r_m3  - r_base)
fell_m2  = where(is_fell, r_m2  - r_base)
fell_m1  = where(is_fell, 0.0)
fell_0   = where(is_fell, r_0   - r_base)
fell_p1  = where(is_fell, r_p1  - r_base)
fell_p2  = where(is_fell, r_p2  - r_base)
fell_p3  = where(is_fell, r_p3  - r_base)
fell_p4  = where(is_fell, r_p4  - r_base)
fell_p5  = where(is_fell, r_p5  - r_base)
fell_p6  = where(is_fell, r_p6  - r_base)
fell_p7  = where(is_fell, r_p7  - r_base)
fell_p8  = where(is_fell, r_p8  - r_base)
fell_p9  = where(is_fell, r_p9  - r_base)
fell_p10 = where(is_fell, r_p10 - r_base)

# === SUMMARY STATISTICS ===
event_count    = where(is_event, 1.0)
chg_m1_to_0    = where(is_event, r_0 - r_base)
chg_0_to_p5    = where(is_event, (ratio << 5) - ratio)
chg_0_to_p10   = where(is_event, (ratio << 10) - ratio)
pct_rose       = where(is_event, 1.0 if ratio_rose_flag else 0.0)

# === PER-YEAR BAR DATA ===
event_year = where(is_event, yr)
year_chg_m1_to_p5 = where(is_event, (ratio << 5) - r_base)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- 1. Summary Table: Key Stats ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='USDA Prospective Plantings: Corn/Soy Ratio Impact',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['Corn/Soy Ratio'],
        col_headers=['Events', 'Avg Chg Day -1→0', 'Avg Chg Day 0→+5', 'Avg Chg Day 0→+10', '% Ratio Rose'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Sum, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=0)
        ]
    ),
    category='Planting Intentions',
    order=0
)(event_count, chg_m1_to_0, chg_0_to_p5, chg_0_to_p10, pct_rose)

# --- 2. XY Bars: Average Normalized Path (All Events) ---
# Using series mode: 21 bars from offset -10 to +10, aggregated as Mean
xy_bars(
    title='Avg Corn/Soy Ratio Path Around Planting Intentions Release',
    category='Planting Intentions',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg Ratio Change from Day -1',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='-10', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='-9', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='-8', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='-7', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='-6', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='-5', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='-4', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='-3', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='-2', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='-1', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='0', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+2', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+3', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+4', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+6', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+7', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+8', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+9', color=Color.Indigo),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+10', color=Color.Indigo)
    ]),
    order=1
)(n_m10, n_m9, n_m8, n_m7, n_m6, n_m5, n_m4, n_m3, n_m2, n_m1, n_0, n_p1, n_p2, n_p3, n_p4, n_p5, n_p6, n_p7, n_p8, n_p9, n_p10)

# --- 3. XY Bars: Average Path Split by Regime (Rose vs Fell) ---
# Grouped bar chart: x-axis categories = offsets, grouped by regime
xy_bars(
    title='Post-Release Paths Diverge: Ratio Rose vs Ratio Fell',
    category='Planting Intentions',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_label='Avg Ratio Change from Day -1',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rose', color=Color.Blue, stack='-10'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Fell', color=Color.Gray, stack='-10'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rose', color=Color.Blue, stack='-5'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Fell', color=Color.Gray, stack='-5'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rose', color=Color.Blue, stack='-1'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Fell', color=Color.Gray, stack='-1'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rose', color=Color.Blue, stack='0'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Fell', color=Color.Gray, stack='0'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rose', color=Color.Blue, stack='+1'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Fell', color=Color.Gray, stack='+1'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rose', color=Color.Blue, stack='+5'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Fell', color=Color.Gray, stack='+5'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Rose', color=Color.Blue, stack='+10'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Fell', color=Color.Gray, stack='+10')
    ]),
    order=2
)(rose_m10, fell_m10, rose_m5, fell_m5, rose_m1, fell_m1, rose_0, fell_0, rose_p1, fell_p1, rose_p5, fell_p5, rose_p10, fell_p10)

# --- 4. XY Bars: Per-Year Day -1 to +5 Ratio Change ---
xy_bars(
    title='Planting Intentions Impact by Year (Day -1 to +5)',
    category='Planting Intentions',
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_label='Ratio Change (Day -1 to +5)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=4,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=3
)(year_chg_m1_to_p5, event_year)

# --- 5. Event Markers on ratio time series ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='USDA Prospective Plantings',
        icon=Icon.CalendarIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Ratio (Day 0)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Chg Day -1 to 0', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Chg Day 0 to +5', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Chg Day 0 to +10', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title='Regime', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat)
        ]
    )
)(is_event, where(is_event, ratio), chg_m1_to_0, chg_0_to_p5, chg_0_to_p10, where(is_event, "Rose" if ratio_rose_flag else "Fell"))
